subject: feat(flags): put a percentage rollout on a flag

defects.regex: (negativ[a-z]*|below zero|less than zero|signed (32|int)|int32|unsigned|absolute value|two.s complement)[^.]{0,70}(bucket|hash|modul|remainder|rollout)|(bucket|hash32|hashes|modulo|remainder)[^.]{0,70}(negativ[a-z]*|below zero|less than zero|signed|unsigned|absolute value|two.s complement)|(about|roughly|nearly|around) half|half of (all|the|every)|(bucket|bucketFor)[^.]{0,60}(-99|minus 99|range of -)
defects.defect: bucketFor in src/rollout.js takes the remainder of src/hash.js's hash32 without putting it on the positive side, so a caller whose hash comes out under zero gets a bucket under zero and clears every `bucket < percent` test. Enable checkout-v2, set its rollout to 1, and `evaluator.isOn("checkout-v2", { userId: "ada" })` reads true, as it does for about half of any list of callers.

defects.regex: (rollout|percentage)[^.]{0,60}((is|are|gets?|will be) (not|never)? ?(saved|persisted|serialised|serialized|written|kept|stored)|lost|dropped|gone|disappear|thrown away|does not survive|will not survive|missing from)|(save|saved|saving|persist[a-z]*|serialis[a-z]*|serializ[a-z]*|restore[a-z]*|round.?trip|backup)[^.]{0,60}(drops?|loses?|lost|strips?|omits?|forgets?|leaves out|does not (keep|carry|include|record)|without the rollout|silently)|FIELDS[^.]{0,45}(missing|never|does not|lacks|without|untouched|unchanged|not updated|no rollout)|(reverts?|falls? back|back to)[^.]{0,50}(boolean|on for everyone|all callers|hundred per cent|100)
defects.defect: The change puts a new `rollout` field on a flag but never adds it to the FIELDS list in the untouched src/serializer.js, so save and restore keep everything but the rollout. Put checkout-v2 at ten per cent, run persist.save() and persist.restore() on it, and the flag is on for every caller again, dennis included.

(the same|a|its) [`'\"]?(object|reference|rollout)|points? to the same|shallow (cop|clone|spread)|Object\.assign[^.]{0,70}(mutat|in place|target|same object|first argument|existing)|(mutat|chang|updat|writ)[a-z]*[^.]{0,35}in place|(before|old)[^.]{0,60}(after|new)[^.]{0,40}(the same|identical|both read|both show|point)|(before|old value|old percentage)[^.]{0,70}(reads?|shows?|carries|records?|reports?|ends? up with|will be)[^.]{0,35}(the new|the same|updated|current) (percent|percentage|value|rollout)|audit[^.]{0,70}(both|same on both|identical|new percentage as the old|useless)
defects.defect: setRollout in src/admin.js takes its before snapshot with flags.view, which src/flag.js spreads one level deep, and then hands the flag's own rollout object to Object.assign as the target, so the snapshot moves with it. Set checkout-v2 to ten per cent and then to forty, and the last audit entry reads forty in `before` as well as in `after`.
